reason: My problem at month end is receipts that never got sent to the chat, and a bot that only reads what is already in the group does not fix that. I would probably burn the 40 free documents, but I would not start paying $19 a month for something my staff and a shared sheet can mostly do for free.
objection: It organises the receipts I already have, not the ones that are missing, and duplicates are a staff discipline issue I can handle by talking to people. Another monthly subscription has to earn its place every week, and I doubt this one would.
would_change_my_mind: If it chased staff for missing receipts, for example by flagging spending with no matching receipt and pinging the person in the chat, so my accountant actually gets a complete set at month end.
